playstyle.identity: Anivia is a control mage with incredible zone control and a revive passive. She excels at stalling games and controlling chokepoints with her wall and ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q stuns on reactivation (pass through then detonate). W creates impassable terrain. E deals double damage to chilled (Q/R) targets. R is a persistent blizzard zone. Wall enemies into your R, then E for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Anivia spikes at level 6 with her zone control ultimate. Tear stacking and Rod of Ages scale her. She's a late-game monster with waveclear and control.

passive.name: Rebirth
passive.summary: On death, become an egg that revives after a few seconds if not killed.
passive.details: When Anivia takes lethal damage, she transforms into an egg for several seconds. If the egg survives, she's reborn with health. Long cooldown.

abilities.name: Flash Frost
abilities.summary: Launch a slow-moving ball that stuns and chills on reactivation.
abilities.details: Anivia fires a chunk of ice that damages and chills enemies it passes through. Reactivate to detonate, stunning and damaging enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.details: Anivia creates a wall of ice that blocks movement. Can be used to trap enemies, block paths, or interrupt dashes. Doesn't damage.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.summary: Deal damage to a target; deals double damage if they're chilled.
abilities.details: Anivia blasts an enemy with frost, dealing magic damage. If the target was recently damaged by Q or R (chilled), the damage is doubled.

abilities.name: Glacial Storm
abilities.summary: Create a persistent blizzard that chills and damages enemies inside.
abilities.details: Anivia creates an expanding blizzard zone that deals damage per second and chills enemies. Drains mana while active and can be toggled off. Interrupted by CC.
